title: MORNING BELL ROUTINE
description: Each farm morning now begins with a soft bell, gentle tool pickup sounds, dew on the crop rows, and a short stretch animation before the first chore.
consequence: The day gets a handle to pick up.

title: ONE-SWIPE HARVEST
description: Mature crop rows can now be harvested with one smooth held sweep, chaining pickup, sorting, and basket drop-off into a single satisfying pass through the field.
consequence: The field stops taking an afternoon.

title: MODULAR TOOL SOCKETS
description: Axes, picks, and shovels now accept swappable heads, grips, counterweights, and charm slots, each changing swing arcs, stamina cost, and material yield in small incompatible ways.
consequence: The toolbox gets interesting enough to trip over.

title: HELPFUL CARD COACH
description: New runs now include a cheerful MS Office-style paperclip advisor that highlights recommended cards, explains risky plays, warns before unusual combos, and asks for confirmation when the deck starts doing anything weird.
consequence: The deck gets MS Office supervision vibes.
